interface.name: jwm_readonly_popup_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: Trusted-local capability. One source may be derived from a live same-client toplevel source, consuming its input attempts. Includes only bounded same-client xdg popups whose exact parent chain terminates at the selected root. Clips to the fixed root canvas. Never grants popup input, root expansion or resize-follow. Destruction and lifecycle invalidation permanently stop the derived source.
